title: Summary approval
description: When someone pastes a text into the page, the configured AI model writes a short summary of it, and the summary waits for a person to approve it in Studio before it is saved. A truncated summary is saved without waiting, and a blocked, refused or failed answer is recorded with what went wrong instead of a summary. Without its optional model connection, the page remains available and summaries show how to connect an LLM.

requirements.title: Summary approval
requirements.summary: A person approves each generated summary in Studio before it is saved.

features.text: A Step AwaitSummaryApproval holds the generated summary and shows awaiting-approval until a person decides.
features.untested_reason: A person approves in Studio, which the API tests do not drive; TestTextSummaryGeneratedWaitsForApproval proves the generated summary reaches the waiting Step.

features.text: An Approve summary Action releases that Step, which then saves the summary.
features.untested_reason: The Approve summary Action is a Studio action, which the API tests do not drive.

acceptance: The summary is saved only after Approve summary is chosen in a Studio run.

design.summary: The summary run waits after generation until a person approves it in Studio; then it is saved. Missing optional model configuration produces a connect-an-LLM notice without a provider call.

flows.purpose: Summarizes a text with a model and saves it once a person approves.

steps.explanation: Validate and keep the text before any paid model request.

next.when: the text is empty, too long or not UTF-8
the optional summary-model connection is not configured

steps.explanation: Ask the configured model for a short factual summary.

next.when: blocked, rejected, invalid or a defect

steps.explanation: Wait for a person to approve the generated summary before it is saved.
Save the summary, the model and the token usage.
Record why the model returned no usable summary.
Record a lost model response without sending the paid request again.

attributes.name: SummaryStatus
attributes.value: pending, awaiting-approval, approved, completed or failed
